definitions.explanation: The first warrior government of Japan, founded by Minamoto no Yoritomo with its seat at Kamakura. It lasted until 1333, when it was overthrown in support of Emperor Go-Daigo.

examples.japanese: {鎌倉幕府|かまくらばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{源頼朝|みなもとのよりとも}→源頼朝：31065_minamotonoyoritomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Kamakura shogunate was founded by Minamoto no Yoritomo.

examples.japanese: {鎌倉幕府|かまくらばくふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1333⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{滅|ほろ}びた→滅びる：10881_horobiru⟧。

⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧つくろう」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{語呂合|ごろあ}わせ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鎌倉幕府|かまくらばくふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: People used to memorize the founding date of the Kamakura shogunate with the wordplay "ii kuni tsukurō" (1192).

notes:
⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧ + ⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧ (shogunate). The founding date is a well-known school topic: older textbooks gave 1192, when Yoritomo became {征夷大将軍|せいいたいしょうぐん}, remembered as ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧つくろう; many now give 1185, when he gained the right to appoint provincial officials, remembered as ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧つくろう.
